name: Blood Moon leeches 3% of damage below 75% health and adds an amalgam (#3142)
contract: The issue names two unrelated records that share the name Blood Moon. 804199 is SPELL_EFFECT_APPLY_AURA with aura 107 SPELL_AURA_ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER, MiscValue 3 = SPELLMOD_EFFECT1, BasePoints 0 + DieSides 1 = +1 and SpellClassMask (1, 0, 0), which matches the three Animated Blood ranks (573299, 573356, 573357, all family 26 with SpellFamilyFlags (1, 0, 0)). Each is a SPELL_EFFECT_SUMMON with MiscValueB 61, and Spell::EffectSummonType takes the summon count from the effect value for that SummonProperties id, so +1 on 573357 (MiscValue 315301, BasePoints 0 + DieSides 1 = 1 amalgam) is literally "an additional amalgam". spell_effect_value queries SpellEffectInfo::CalcValue directly, which is the number EffectSummonType reads, and avoids 573357's 30-second category cooldown. That half works natively. 707623 is the broken half: its single effect is SPELL_EFFECT_APPLY_AURA with aura 354, BasePoints 2 + DieSides 1 = the 3% of "While below 75% health, you now heal for 3% of all damage you deal", and TriggerSpell Blood Moon 572786, a SPELL_EFFECT_HEAL with BasePoints 0. Aura 354 has no AuraEffectHandler entry, no AuraEffect::HandleProc case and is not an isTriggerAura, and 707623's own ProcFlags are 0, so SpellMgr generated no SpellProcEntry at all and the talent did nothing. Valanar's Vengeance 572795 is the probe - the rank a level-80 character owns, a pure SPELL_EFFECT_SCHOOL_DAMAGE with no leech of its own - and the caster is in combat throughout, so Player::RegenerateHealth contributes nothing and a health gain can only come from the proc. The 75% suppression is not asserted: set_health takes an absolute value and the fixture's maximum health is not known to the scenario, so only the below-threshold side is observable here; health_pct is asserted to record that the precondition held.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Animated Blood rank 3 summons one amalgam before the talent
The caster is in combat, so health regeneration is off
Control: damage heals nothing without the talent
The caster is below the talent's 75% threshold
Blood Moon heals the wounded caster from the damage dealt
